Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4513219. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as inner join, filter activities by assay_id matching CHEMBL4513219 and standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
